reason: When I am at my other work I have no idea who is in which chair or how much cash should be in the drawer, and cancelled bills and walkouts are exactly where money goes missing. For ₹10,000 and ₹500 a month that is nothing next to what one dishonest day costs me, so I would try it.
objection: It is only in English. Half my stylists will not read English screens properly, and if they find it hard they will quietly go back to writing in the register and the app will show me nothing. I also do not know who you are or whether you will still be there next year.
would_change_my_mind: If my staff refuse to use it in the first two weeks because it is English only, I will stop paying. Odia or Hindi screens for the stylists would remove that worry completely.
